sample_rows.reason: Large enough for stable correlations and model checks, small enough to keep S and E checks fast.

parse_sample_rows.reason: Type parse attempts run on this sample first; the full column is parsed only if the sample passes.

discrete_max_unique.reason: Integer columns with at most 30 values behave like counts or scores; a unique ratio breaks on large data.

min_missing_share.reason: A row with half of its cells missing carries little information and is often a broken record.

min_parse_share.reason: If 95% of values are numbers after cleaning, the rest are most likely tokens or typos, not real categories.
Date columns often have a few placeholder or broken values; 90% is still a clear majority.

min_minority_share.reason: A second pattern in less than 1% of values is noise; above it, the column really mixes formats.

min_fixed_length_share.reason: Codes like zip codes have the same digit count in almost every row.

min_similarity.reason: Labels this similar (for example one typo in a long word) are likely the same category.

should_fix_min_share.reason: Below 5% missing, simple imputation rarely changes the model, so it is only a note.

must_fix_min_share.reason: Above 40% missing, imputation invents a large part of the column, so a decision is required.

min_spike_share.reason: A sentinel value repeats in many rows; below 0.5% it is not a clear spike.

min_gap_iqr.reason: A min or max value that is 3 IQRs away from the next value is cut off from the normal range.

max_p_value.reason: A strict test level, because this test runs on many columns.

min_effect_size.reason: Cohen's small effect size; smaller differences are not useful for the model.

min_jaccard.reason: Columns missing in 90% of the same rows share one cause.

min_missing_share.reason: With 5% or less of values present, the column can not be imputed in a reliable way.

max_negative_share.reason: A few negatives (under 1%) in an otherwise non-negative column are likely errors, not a real range.

percent_max.reason: Percentage values can not be above 100.

rate_min.reason: Rates and shares can not be below 0.

rate_max.reason: Rates and shares can not be above 1.

min_robust_z.reason: A robust z-score above 10 is far beyond normal tails, even for skewed data.

max_share.reason: Isolated values are rare; if more than 1% of values are flagged, the column has a heavy tail, not typos.

min_gap_iqr.reason: A value 5 IQRs away from the next value is isolated (for example bedrooms = 33).

min_rule_share.reason: A rule that holds in 95% of rows is a real rule; the rows that break it are likely errors.

min_count.reason: A category with fewer than 10 rows can not be learned and may be missing from some CV folds.

min_top_share.reason: If one value covers 99% of rows, the column carries almost no information.

min_unique_share.reason: ID columns are almost fully unique; repeated ids (for example resales) still reach 99%.

min_rows.reason: With few rows, many normal columns are fully unique by chance.

min_pattern_length.reason: A fixed length counts as an ID pattern only for long values; short numbers like ages often share a length.

max_levels.reason: One-hot encoding above 50 levels makes the data wide and sparse.

max_level_share.reason: More levels than 5% of rows means few rows per level.

min_levels.reason: The 5% rule only applies from 10 levels, so small datasets with a few levels are not flagged.

min_mean_words.reason: Category labels usually have 1 to 3 words; longer values are free text.

min_unique_share.reason: Free text is mostly unique, unlike repeated category labels.

svd_tolerance.reason: A singular value this small, relative to the largest, means an exact linear relation.

confirm_tolerance.reason: The relation must hold on the full data up to rounding errors.

max_columns.reason: Above 200 numeric columns (for example after one-hot encoding) the SVD is slow; the check is skipped and recorded in coverage.

min_abs_spearman.reason: Two columns with rank correlation of 0.95 or more carry almost the same information.

max_columns.reason: Above 1,000 numeric columns the correlation matrix gets too large; the check is skipped and recorded in coverage.

min_abs_skew.reason: A common rule of thumb: skew above 2 is a heavy skew.

regression_max_unique.reason: A regression target with 10 or fewer values may be a class label.

classification_min_numeric_levels.reason: A numeric class label with 5 or more ordered values may be a score better treated as ordinal or regression.

min_ratio.reason: Above a 2:1 majority/minority ratio, default classifiers start to favor the majority class.

levels.reason: Ratio bands copied from the old tool, for the imbalance level in the evidence.

min_rows.reason: A class needs at least 10 rows to appear in every CV fold and be learned.

cv_folds.reason: The usual number of CV folds; a class needs at least one row per fold.

min_abs_skew.reason: Same rule of thumb as E09, applied to the target.

min_robust_z.reason: Same rule as D02, applied to the target.

min_auc.reason: One feature alone with AUC 0.98 is almost a copy of the target.

min_r2.reason: One feature alone with R2 0.95 is almost a copy of the target.

tree_depth.reason: A shallow tree finds simple leaks without overfitting.

cv_folds.reason: The usual number of CV folds.

max_features.reason: One CV tree per feature; above 500 features the check is skipped and recorded in coverage.

min_purity.reason: Categories with 99% of rows in one target value give away the target.

min_row_share.reason: The pure categories must cover most rows to be a leak, not a few rare cases.

min_class_share.reason: If 95% of the missing values are in one class, missingness gives away the target.

min_abs_rank_corr.reason: A small but real trend over time already makes a random split too optimistic.

max_p_value.reason: A strict test level, to avoid false time-split advice.

time_bins.reason: Ten bins show a drift and keep enough rows per bin.

min_abs_rank_corr.reason: A strong link between row order and target or time means the file is sorted.

round_decimals.reason: Rows that are equal after rounding to 2 decimals are near duplicates.

min_rows.reason: Below 500 rows, a single test split is too noisy; use CV.

min_rows_per_feature.reason: Fewer than 20 rows per feature makes overfitting likely.

max_column_growth.reason: If encoding makes 10 times more columns than the input had, the data becomes too wide.

same_rows_min_jaccard.reason: Issues on 90% of the same rows likely share one cause.

contrast_top_k.reason: Three contrast columns explain a row set and keep the evidence short.

contrast_min_difference.reason: Only strong contrasts (a share difference of 0.5 or more) are kept as evidence.

max_tokens.reason: issues.md must fit in the context of the pipeline's LLM agents.

chars_per_token.reason: A rough token estimate for English text.

min_share.reason: If 90% of the values are a number followed by a unit, the column is a measured amount written as text.

min_present.reason: With fewer values a unit pattern can be chance.

min_template_share.reason: When the three most common digit templates cover 80% of the values, the column has a fixed packed format.

min_slots.reason: A packed value holds at least two numbers; one number is a unit or code case.

min_present.reason: With fewer values a template pattern can be chance.

min_date_share.reason: The column must be mostly dates; otherwise mixed formats are a B03 case.

min_minority_share.reason: A second date format in less than 1% of values is noise.

min_present.reason: With fewer values a second format can be chance.
